svg.title: End-to-end data flow
svg.desc: How data moves from OneDrive Excel through Microsoft Graph API, FastAPI backend, and into the React dashboard

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How is the OneDrive Excel file structured?')
sendPrompt('What Microsoft Graph API endpoint reads Excel data?')
sendPrompt('What does the FastAPI backend do with the Excel data?')
sendPrompt('What data does the /availability endpoint return?')
sendPrompt('What do the 4 dashboard views look like?')
sendPrompt('What does the manager see on the dashboard?')
